content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to connect to a [product_name] device using an Ethernet cable for real-time or online monitoring? I've already uploaded my program to the [product_name] unit, but now I want to observe its current operation directly within the unit. Hope my question is clear, even though I'm new to this. Apologies for my English! Thanks!

Yes, that's possible. Refer to the attached information. Within the diagram editor of the programming software, there's an 'Online test' button (highlighted with a red circle). This button enables or disables the online monitoring mode.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking ways to observe real-time program status inside a [product_name] device using an Ethernet connection after uploading their programs. Immediate access to live monitoring from the programming software is important for a smooth user experience. A clear answer with supporting documentation resolves the question, emphasizing the importance of accessible UI features and good documentation for live program monitoring.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a simple and straightforward process for connecting to a [product_name] device and monitoring live program status via Ethernet using the programming software.
